about.text: A traditional Lithuanian way of keeping soured milk through the winter, made during Lent. The cream and whey were drained off, the soured milk was poured into a small tub and covered to last the winter, and until the First World War it was eaten in early spring and during the summer work.

sources.text: The Lenten method, the tub and winter storage, and eating before the First World War, from this article.
